diagnostics.message: :resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this is redundant — already implied by attribute references

The explicit depends_on from :resource.null_resource.wait_for_cluster to :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this duplicates the implicit dependency: the provisioner's ENDPOINT environment value references aws_eks_cluster.this[0].endpoint.

The worker Auto Scaling group can launch instances before the default worker role has AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy attached. Its launch configuration/profile does not depend on the attachment, so Terraform may create the ASG before nodes have the permissions needed to register with EKS.

The worker Auto Scaling group can launch instances before AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy is attached to the default worker role. Add ordering so node networking is not initialized before the required CNI permissions are available.
